data.name: Islam
data.gender_notes: Islam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Islam is the religion of peace, submission to Allah (God), and obedience to His will. It was founded by Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in the 7th century CE in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. Islam teaches the oneness of God and the importance of moral values, such as honesty, compassion, and generosity. The name Islam carries the meaning “Submission to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Islam usually hope their child will grow to embody submission to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Submission to the will of Allah
data.etymology: Islam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Submission to Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Islam total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: إسلام
in_arabic.meaning: الإسلام هو دين الله الحق والسلام للإنس والجن
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإسلام هو دين الله الحق الذي جاء به جميع الأنبياء والرسل، وهو دين السلام والرحمة للإنس والجن، ويعني الاستسلام لله وحده لا شريك له، والانقياد لأوامره ونواهيه، والإيمان بجميع الأنبياء والرسل والكتب السماوية

in_urdu.name: اسلام
in_urdu.meaning: اسلام حق دین ہے اور اللہ تعالی کا شریعت ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسلام اللہ تعالی کا حق دین ہے جو تمام انبیاء و رسل کے ذریعے سے آیا ہے، اور یہ دین انسانوں اور جنوں کے لئے سلامتی اور رحمت کا دین ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ تعالی کے لئے اپنی زندگی کو وقف کرنا، اور اس کی احکام و نواهی کی پیروی کرنا

in_hindi.name: इस्लाम
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लाम ईश्वर की सच्ची और शुद्ध भक्ति है
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस्लाम ईश्वर की सच्ची और शुद्ध भक्ति है जो सभी पैगंबरों और प्रेरितों के माध्यम से आई है, और यह मानव और अन्य सृष्टियों के लिए शांति और करुणा का धर्म है, जिसका अर्थ है केवल ईश्वर के लिए अपना जीवन समर्पित करना और उसकी आज्ञाओं और निषेधों का पालन करना

in_pashto.name: اسلام
in_pashto.meaning: اسلام د الله پاک يو دين دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسلام د الله پاک يو دين دی چې د ټولو پيغمبرانو او رسولانو په لارې راغلی دی، او دا دين د انسانانو او جنيانو لپاره د سولې او رحمې دين دی، چې معنی یې د الله پاک په وړاندې خپل ژوند وقف کول او د هغه په احکامو او نواهيو پوهیدل دي

in_english.long_meaning: Islam is the monotheistic faith that originated with the prophetic message of Abraham, Moses, Jesus, and other biblical figures, ultimately revealed through the Prophet Muhammad, emphasizing submission to God's sovereignty, adherence to the Quran, and observance of the Five Pillars

data.cultural_impact: Islam has had a profound impact on world history, becoming one of the major world religions and shaping the cultures of the Middle East, North Africa, and Central and South Asia. Many of its cultural contributions, such as the development of mathematics, science, art, literature, and the spread of the Arabic language, have had a lasting impact on global civilization.
data.spiritual_significance: Islam is based on the belief in one all-powerful God (Allah) and the belief that Muhammad (pbuh) is His last and final messenger. It teaches the importance of living a moral and virtuous life, and emphasizes the spiritual significance of prayer, fasting, and giving to charity. Muslims believe that submission to Allah's will (Islam means submission) leads to inner peace and ultimate happiness in both this life and the next.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Submission to Allah" symbolizes Islam is the religion of peace, submission to Allah (God), and obedience to His will. It was founded by Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in the 7th century CE in Mecca, Saudi Arabia. Islam teaches the oneness of God and the importance of moral values, such as honesty, compassion, and generosity.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Islam serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of submission to allah.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: The term 'Islam' is derived from an Arabic root word 'aslama', meaning 'submission' or 'surrender', which refers to the total surrender of one's will to God (Allah).
historical_references.context: The emergence of Islam as a monotheistic faith in the Arabian Peninsula.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Islam' became widely used during the time of the Prophet Muhammad (570-632 CE). The term was adopted to distinguish the new monotheistic faith from other religions in the region, particularly Christianity and Judaism.
historical_references.context: The consolidation of the Islamic community and the spread of the religion beyond the Arabian Peninsula.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Islam remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
